finding.description: The clean PR candidate build succeeded but packed the shared 0.11.2 README into the five 0.11.3 packages. Build-WorkspacePackages selected version-specific release notes but omitted ArchSiftPackageReadme. Independent artifact review rejected the candidate.
finding.disposition: Rejected for release qualification; preserve original artifact and build records.
